mechanism: Duplicate the complete frozen LA1 user request with LF LF, in the SAME single user message. Add only fixed two-views-one-message clarification. Keep source bytes, frozen base instructions including existing sense groups, schema, units extraction, disabled/low/2048 unchanged.
